blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Synthesizing physically grounded dexterous hand-object interactions is important for VR/AR, gaming, and robotics, yet remains challenging because subtle contact dynamics, diverse object geometries, and target trajectories must be jointly respected while maintaining natural grasps. Existing methods either track mocap trajectories with limited transfer to novel objects, or rely on hand-only generative priors that fail to capture coupled hand-object motion, sacrificing contact fidelity and sample efficiency. To tackle these challenges, we introduce PiHand, a Physically grounded Interaction-aware Hand motion synthesis framework. PiHand first trains expert policies that track mocap demonstrations in simulation, distills them into a unified hand-object interaction prior using a goal-conditioned VAE, and finally solve diverse dexterous manipulation tasks through bounded residual exploration in its latent space. With only a single reward and no complex curriculum training, this yields general tabletop manipulation policies that generalize to unseen objects and trajectories on GRAB and DexYCB. The same prior transfers to object catching and bimanual handover, two tasks that are rarely seen in its training data. Across all tasks, PiHand consistently outperforms baselines in all metrics. We will release the processed data and model checkpoints.
blocks.zh: 合成物理上基底的脱落手物相互作用对于VR/AR,游戏,机器人都很重要,然而仍然具有挑战性,因为微妙的接触动态,多样的物体几何,以及目标轨迹在保持自然把握的同时必须共同尊重. 现有的方法要么是追踪摩卡普轨迹,有限地转移给新颖物体,要么是依靠只掌握基因的前科,无法捕捉到结合的手物体运动,牺牲接触忠心和样本效率. 为了应对这些挑战,我们引入了PiHand,即一个具有物理基础的互动意识手动综合框架。 PiHand首先训练专家政策,在模拟中跟踪摩卡普演示,在使用有目标条件的VAE之前将其蒸馏成一个统一的手物体交互,最后通过在潜伏空间的有界限的剩余探索,解决了多种多样的离心操纵任务. 仅通过一次奖励和不进行复杂的课程培训,就产生了一般桌面操纵政策,将GRAB和DexYCB上的物体和轨迹普遍化。 先前转让的同样是捕获对象和双人移交,这两项任务很少见于培训数据。 在所有任务中,PiHand始终超越所有衡量基准。 我们将公布经处理的数据和示范检查站。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Generating realistic hand-object interactions is a foundational challenge in computer vision and graphics, with implications for VR/AR, gaming and robotics. Several kinematic approaches ( Cha et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025b ; Zhang et al., 2025b ) have made significant strides in generating such interactions from visual or textual inputs, yet they frequently suffer from noticeable physical implausibilities which make them unfit for deployment in simulated environments or on real-world robots. To bridge this gap, the robotics and physics-based animation communities have focused on learning generative control policies to synthesize the complex motions required to stably grasp and manipulate objects based on their geometry and target trajectory inside simulation. Yet this remains challenging because contact dynamics are subtle and discrete, objects vary widely in geometry and affordances, and the hand must continuously adapt its grasp and contact configuration to remain both natural-looking and physically correct.
blocks.zh: 生成现实的手-对象交互是计算机视觉和图形中的基础挑战,对VR/AR,游戏和机器人都有影响. 若干动能方法(Cha等人,2024年;Li等人,2025年b;Zhang等人,2025年b)在通过视觉或文字输入产生这种相互作用方面已取得重大进展,但它们经常受到明显的身体不合理的影响,因此不适合在模拟环境中或现实世界机器人上部署。 为了弥合这一差距,机器人和以物理为基础的动画社区侧重于学习基因控制政策,以根据几何和目标轨迹在模拟中稳定地抓住和操纵物体所需的复杂运动。 然而,这仍然具有挑战性,因为接触动态微妙而离散,物体在几何和承受力上差异很大,手必须不断调整其抓住和接触的布局,使其保持自然外观和物理正确.

blocks.en: Physics-based tracking controllers imitate mocap sequences ( Li et al., 2025a ; Liu et al., 2025a ) with strong realism and sim-to-real transfer, but remain reconstructive: their reliance on dense references prevents synthesis or adaptation to new objects without corresponding mocap. Conversely, generative RL methods such as GraspXL ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) generalize to unseen objects. But such dexterous-hand exploration in action space requires engineered rewards and curricula, remains sample-inefficient, and often yields unnatural motion. PULSE ( Luo et al., 2024b ) learns reusable latent humanoid control spaces, which Omnigrasp ( Luo et al., 2024a ) applies to object-centric tasks. Yet these human-only priors do not model object interactions, forcing policies to discover contacts in a latent space unstructured for them and limiting scalability to complex, dynamic tasks.
blocks.zh: 基于物理的跟踪控制器模仿了mocap序列 (Li等,2025a;Liu等,2025a) 具有强烈的现实主义和sim-to-real transfer,但保持了重建性:他们依赖密集的引用会阻碍合成或适应新物体而无需相应的mocap. 反之,GraspXL(张等,2025a)等基因RL方法被概括到看不见的物体. 但是,在行动空间进行这种狡猾的手动探索需要设计出奖励和课程,仍然缺乏样本效率,往往产生非自然运动。 PULSE(Luo等,2024b)学习了可再用的潜在人形控制空间,Omnigrasp(Luo等,2024a)适用于以物体为中心的任务. 然而,这些仅限人的前科并没有模拟物体的相互作用,迫使政策在一个潜在的空间中发现接触,而这种接触是无法安排的,并且将可扩展性限制在复杂而动态的任务上。

blocks.en: In this work, we demonstrate that an interaction prior consistently outperforms both action-space exploration and hand-only priors in sample efficiency, spatial accuracy and tracking robustness. We propose PiHand , a P hysically grounded I nteraction-aware Hand motion synthesis framework that efficiently generates high-quality hand-object interactions, generalizes to new objects and transfers to unseen dexterous tasks. Instead of relying on brittle reward engineering or “blind” motion priors, our core insight is to embed the interaction itself into the foundation of the latent space. We argue that such an “interaction-first” approach is essential to capture the subtle, contact-rich patterns of human grasping and to construct a well-behaved latent manifold that enables efficient synthesis across novel objects, trajectories and tasks. Specifically, we propose a three-stage pipeline: we first train specialized expert policies in a physics simulator to track hand–object interactions from mocap data, then distill these experts into an object- and contact-aware latent interaction prior, and finally solve new tasks by residual RL exploration within this latent space.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们表明,在样本效率、空间精确度和跟踪稳健性方面,事先的互动一贯优于行动空间探索和只手前科。 我们提出PiHand, 一个物理上基础的 I nteraction-aware Hand 运动合成框架, 高效地生成高质量的手物体相互作用, 概括到新的物体上, 并转移到隐形的去。 我们的核心见解是将相互作用本身嵌入潜在空间的基础,而不是依赖不折不扣的奖励工程或“盲从”运动前科。 我们认为,这种“互动先行”的做法对于抓住微妙而富于接触的人类掌握模式和构建良好的潜在多元性至关重要,能够有效地综合各种新事物、轨迹和任务。 具体地说,我们提出一个三阶段的管道:我们首先在一个物理模拟器中训练专门的专家政策,以跟踪摩克数据中的手-物体相互作用,然后将这些专家蒸馏成一个物体和接触意识的潜在相互作用,最后通过在这个潜在空间中进行残留的RL探索来解决新的任务。

blocks.en: Experiments show that our imitation experts improve success rate (SR) over the state-of-the-art tracking method from 69.6% to 93.3%, providing accurate data for distillation. Using only a simple object-tracking reward, our interaction prior enables tabletop policies to manipulate unseen objects along unseen trajectories with 14.0 and 16.9 percentage points higher SR on GRAB ( Taheri et al., 2020 ) and DexYCB ( Chao et al., 2021 ) , respectively. The same prior transfers to object catching absent from its training data and sparsely observed bimanual handover, achieving 2.0 × 2.0\times and 4.3 × 4.3\times the strongest-baseline SR, respectively.
blocks.zh: 实验显示,我们的仿真专家比最先进的跟踪方法提高了成功率(SR)从69.6%提高到93.3%,为蒸馏提供了准确的数据. 仅使用简单的对象跟踪奖励,我们的交互作用使平板电脑政策能够按照未见的轨迹操纵未见的物体,在GRAB(Taheri等,2020年)和DexYCB(Chao等,2021年)上分别以14.0和16.9个百分点更高的SR. 先前的转让与培训数据缺失的捕捉对象相同,很少观察到双人交接,分别实现了2.0×2.0\时间和4.3×4.3\时间的最强基线SR。

blocks.en: In summary, our main contributions are:
blocks.zh: 总之,我们的主要贡献是:

blocks.en: • Data-Driven Interaction Prior for Efficient RL: We introduce a data-driven hand-object interaction prior that allows efficient RL policy learning for dexterous manipulation, bridging mocap-based human priors with physics-based reinforcement learning. • High-Fidelity Interaction Experts: We learn physically accurate interaction experts to track reference mocap demonstrations for the GRAB dataset, providing a valuable resource for the community and a foundation for learning from human demonstrations. • Generalizable and Reusable Interaction Synthesis: We show that our learned single interaction prior supports unseen objects and trajectories on GRAB and DexYCB, transfers to rare bimanual handovers and unseen object-catching tasks, and consistently outperforms baselines in success rate and spatial controllability.
blocks.zh: • 高效RL的数据驱动交互:我们先采用数据驱动的手-对象交互,以便高效地进行RL政策学习,进行去xterous的操纵,将基于mocap的人类前科与基于物理的强化学习相衔接。 • 高可靠性互动专家: 我们学习物理上准确的互动专家,以跟踪GRAB数据集的参考模具演示,为社区提供了宝贵的资源并提供了从人类演示中学习的基础。 • 可概括和可再利用的相互作用综合: 我们显示,我们以往学到的单一互动支持在GRAB和DexYCB上的不见物体和轨迹,向罕见的双人交接和不见对象捕捉任务转移,并在成功率和空间可控性方面始终超越基线。

blocks.en: Data-Driven Interaction Prior for Efficient RL: We introduce a data-driven hand-object interaction prior that allows efficient RL policy learning for dexterous manipulation, bridging mocap-based human priors with physics-based reinforcement learning.
blocks.zh: 高效RL的数据驱动交互:我们引入了由数据驱动的手对象交互前,允许高效的RL政策学习来进行去xterous的操纵,将基于mocap的人类前科与基于物理的强化学习相接.

blocks.en: High-Fidelity Interaction Experts: We learn physically accurate interaction experts to track reference mocap demonstrations for the GRAB dataset, providing a valuable resource for the community and a foundation for learning from human demonstrations.
blocks.zh: 高可靠性互动专家: 我们学习物理上准确的互动专家,以追踪GRAB数据集的参考模具演示,为社区提供了宝贵的资源,并为从人类演示中学习奠定基础。

blocks.en: Generalizable and Reusable Interaction Synthesis: We show that our learned single interaction prior supports unseen objects and trajectories on GRAB and DexYCB, transfers to rare bimanual handovers and unseen object-catching tasks, and consistently outperforms baselines in success rate and spatial controllability.
blocks.zh: 可概括和可再利用的相互作用综合: 我们显示,我们以往学到的单一互动支持在GRAB和DexYCB上的不见物体和轨迹,向罕见的双人交接和不见对象捕捉任务转移,并在成功率和空间可控性方面始终超越基线。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Human and interaction motion imitation. Physics-based motion imitation typically learns reference-conditioned tracking controllers from human motion. Starting from example-guided RL (DeepMimic ( Peng et al., 2018 ) ) and adversarial motion priors/skill embeddings (AMP ( Peng et al., 2021 ) , ASE ( Peng et al., 2022 ) ), recent general motion tracking systems scale to diverse whole-body behaviors and hardware transfer, e.g., PHC ( Luo et al., 2023 ) , HOVER ( He et al., 2025 ) , ExBody2 ( Ji et al., 2024 ) , GMT ( Chen et al., 2025 ) , KungfuBot ( Xie et al., 2025 ) , and camera/teleop-driven imitators such as H2O ( He et al., 2024 ) and TWIST ( Ze et al., 2025 ) . More recently, VideoMimic ( Allshire et al., 2025 ) imitates human motion from video and transfers it to a real robot.
blocks.zh: 人与交互运动模仿. 基于物理的运动仿真一般从人类的运动中学习出参考条件的跟踪控制器. 从以实例为指南的RL(DeepMimic (Peng等,2018年))和对抗性运动前置/技能嵌入(AMP (Peng等,2021年),ASE (Peng等,2022年)开始,最近通用运动跟踪系统规模化为多种全身行为和硬件转移,如PHC(Luo等,2023年),HOER(He等,2025年),ExBody2 (Ji等,2024年),格林尼治平时 (Chen等,2025)., 龚富. Bot (Xie等,2025年),并有相机/电视驱动的仿相器,如H2O (He等,2024年)和TWIST (Ze等,2025年). 最近,VideoMimic(Allshire等,2025年)将人类运动从视频中模仿并转移到了真正的机器人.

blocks.en: Extending imitation to human–object interaction (HOI) requires contact-aware objectives and diverse interaction data: PhysHOI ( Wang et al., 2023 ) introduces contact-graph rewards; SkillMimic ( Wang et al., 2025b ) and SkillMimic-V2 ( Yu et al., 2025 ) learn reusable interaction skills from demonstrations and InterMimic ( Xu et al., 2025 ) scales to varied objects via teacher–student distillation. Recent loco-manipulation frameworks further build on these trackers with residual refinement or generative priors (MaskedManipulator ( Tessler et al., 2025 ) , ResMimic ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) , DreamControl ( Kalaria et al., 2025 ) , VisualMimic ( Yin et al., 2025 ) , CoorDex ( Li et al., 2026 ) ).
blocks.zh: 将模仿推广到人与对象的相互作用(HOI)需要接触意识目标和不同的相互作用数据: PhysHOI(Wang等,2023年)引入了联系图奖励;SkillMimic(Wang等,2025b)和SkillMimic-V2(Yu等,2025年)通过演示和InterMimic(徐等,2025年)通过教师-学生蒸馏来向各种物体学习可再用的互动技能. 近期的loco操纵框架在这些跟踪器的基础上进一步发展了剩余精度或基因前科(MaskedManiplator(Tessler等,2025年),ResMimic(赵等,2025年),Dream Control)。 (Kalaria等,2025年). Visualmic (Yin等,2025年). CoorDex (Li等,2026年).

blocks.en: For hand–object interaction, DexTrack ( Liu et al., 2025a ) , ManipTrans ( Li et al., 2025a ) , AdaDexTrack ( Adalibieke et al., 2026 ) , HOT ( Wang et al., 2025a ) , and DexMachina ( Mandi et al., 2025 ) learn dexterous tracking control from human references, while DexMimicGen ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) and video-based pipelines (DexMV ( Qin et al., 2021 ) , ViViDex ( Chen et al., 2024 ) ) expand demonstration coverage; classic demo-augmented RL (DAPG ( Rajeswaran et al., 2017 ) ) underpins many of these systems. In contrast to predominantly reference-following controllers (or guidance-based synthesis), our method additionally supports generation of novel hand-object motions beyond tracking.
blocks.zh: 关于手-对象相互作用,DexTrack(刘等,2025a),ManipTrans (Li等,2025a.),AdaDexTrack (Adalibieke等,2026.),HOT (Wang等,2025a.),和DexMachina (Mandi等,2025.)从人类的参考文献中学习了离子跟踪控制,而DexMimicGen (Jiang等,2025.)和基于视频的管道(DexMV (Qin等,2021.),ViViDex (Chen等,2024.)) 扩展了示范覆盖范围;经典的降级RL (DAPG (Rajeswaran等,2017.))支撑了许多这些系统. 与以参考为主的跟踪控制器(或以指导为主的合成)形成对比的是,我们的方法还额外支持了新颖的手-对象运动的生成,超越了跟踪.

blocks.en: Interaction motion generation. Physics-based approaches often learn task-specific policies for basketball ( Wang et al., 2025b ; Yu et al., 2025 ) , tennis ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) , bulky-object manipulation ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) , or in-hand rotation ( Liu et al., 2025b ) . Such pipelines require careful reward shaping and curricula and do not readily scale across tasks. To improve reuse and data efficiency, prior work incorporates human-motion representations, ranging from imitation-RL controllers such as DeepMimic ( Peng et al., 2018 ) , AMP ( Peng et al., 2021 ) , and PHC ( Luo et al., 2023 ) to reusable skill priors such as ASE ( Peng et al., 2022 ) . PULSE ( Luo et al., 2024b ) further distills motion-tracking behavior into a conditional latent representation for downstream latent-space RL. Its overall recipe is the closest precursor to PiHand. We follow this recipe but replace PULSE’s human-only whole-body representation with a dexterous hand–object prior that jointly models hand state, object geometry and trajectory, and contact dynamics.
blocks.zh: 互动运动生成. 以物理为主的方法经常学习针对具体任务的政策的篮球(王等,2025b;于等,2025b),网球(张等,2023b),大块物体操纵(郑等,2025b),或手自转(刘等,2025b. 这种管道需要精心制定奖励办法和课程,不能轻易跨越任务。 为提高再利用和数据效率,前期工作纳入了人-运动表示,从模仿-RL控制器,如DeepMimic (Peng等,2018年),AMP (Peng等,2021年),和PHC (Luo等,2023年),到再用技能前身,如ASE (Peng等,2022年). PULSE(Luo等,2024年b)进一步将运动跟踪行为提炼成下游潜-空间RL的有条件潜在代表. 它的总体食谱是皮汉德最接近的前身. 我们遵循这个配方,但将PULSE 的仅人全体代表物取而代之的是一个可调和的手-对象,在此之前,我们共同模拟手态、物体几何和轨迹以及接触动力学。

blocks.en: Building on these priors, recent works move toward modelling object manipulations: Omnigrasp leverages pretrained humanoid motion representations to learn grasp-and-carry across more than 1,000 objects ( Luo et al., 2024a ) , GraspXL scales goal-conditioned grasp-motion synthesis to massive unseen object sets ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) , and MaskedMimic reframes physics-based control as masked motion inpainting conditioned on sparse cues (e.g., keyframes/text/object goals) ( Tessler et al., 2024 ) . TokenHSI further unifies diverse physical human–scene skills via task tokenization in a single transformer policy ( Pan et al., 2025 ) , but still largely relies on human-only priors. Only a few works directly learn interaction priors: concurrent work InterPrior ( Xu et al., 2026 ) distills full-reference HOI experts into a goal-conditioned variational controller and RL-finetunes for generalization, complementary to kinematic HOI priors that explicitly model human–object coupling (DecHOI ( Jung et al., 2025 ) , CoopDiff ( Lin et al., 2025 ) ); MaskedManipulator similarly distills a tracking expert into a goal-conditioned generative loco-manipulation policy over coupled body–object objectives ( Tessler et al., 2025 ) . Orthogonal to these, some kinematic methods ( Li et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2022 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ; Taheri et al., 2022 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Peng et al., 2023 ) learn interaction priors by design but their physical plausibility is limited without simulation. Overall, many systems still rely on human-only priors or task-specific rewards rather than a learned interaction prior, motivating our interaction-first approach for more efficient learning and accurate manipulation.
blocks.zh: 以这些前科为基础,近期的作品走向模拟对象操纵: Omnigrasp利用预先训练的人体活性运动表现来学习跨越1,000多物体的抓取和携带(Luo等,2024a.),GraspXL瞄准镜条件的抓取-运动合成到大型隐形物体组(Zhang等,2025a.),而Maskedmic则将物理控制重新设定为遮盖运动在微弱提示上被涂入的状态(如键框/文本/对象目标) (Tessler等,2024年). 键 HSI通过单一变压器政策(Pan et al.,2025年)中的任务符号化,进一步统一了多样的人体-场景技能,但仍然在很大程度上依赖于人类独有的前科. 只有少数作品直接学习交互前科:同时进行的工作 " InterPrior " (徐等,2026年)将HOI专家充分推荐为目标有条件的变异控制器和RL-finetunes用于通化,补充了明确模拟人类-对象耦合的动能HOI前科(DecHOI (Jung等,2025年),CoopDiff (Lin等,2025年));MaskedManiper同样将一名跟踪专家提炼成目标有条件的基因操纵政策,以取代结合体-对象目标(Tessler等,2025年)。 顺理成章地说,一些动能方法(李等,2023;李等,2024;张等,2022;张等,2024;周等,2024;塔赫里等,2022;吴等,2025;彭等,2023)通过设计学习了相互作用的先入为出,但其物理听力不受模拟的限制. 总体而言,许多系统仍然依赖人独有的前科或特定任务的奖励,而不是事先学会的相互作用,促使我们采取互动的第一办法,以更有效地学习和准确操作。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Figure 2: Method Overview . In Stage I we train expert policies that can track mocap hand-object interactions in a physically simulated environment. In Stage II we then distill the expert knowledge into a VAE-like student network via behavior cloning. The VAE embeds hand-object interactions into a latent space which we leverage in Stage III for efficient sampling and exploration for object trajectory guided motion generation.
blocks.zh: 图2:方法概述. 在第一阶段,我们培训专家政策,在物理模拟环境中跟踪Mocap手动物体的相互作用。 在第二阶段,我们通过行为克隆将专家知识提炼成类似VAE的学生网络。 VAE将手物体的相互作用嵌入一个潜在的空间中,我们在第三阶段利用这个空间来有效地取样和探索物体的导轨运动产生。

blocks.en:
Our method synthesizes physically plausible hand–object interactions conditioned only on a target object trajectory. The key idea is to construct a latent space that embeds data-driven priors of physically simulated hand-object interaction motions. As illustrated in Figure 2 , our pipeline consists of three stages.
In Stage I we learn a set of per-object expert policies that convert noisy mocap demonstrations into physically grounded hand-object interaction motions. In Stage II, we distill the expert’s behaviors into a latent interaction prior. Finally, in Stage III we explore this latent space, allowing the model to efficiently generate new interactions and solve novel tasks.
blocks.zh:
我们的方法合成了物理上可行的手 - 对象相互作用, 仅以目标物体轨迹为条件。 关键的想法是构建一个潜入空间,以嵌入物理模拟手-物体相互作用运动的数据驱动前兆. 如图2所示,我们的管道包括三个阶段。

blocks.en: 3.1 Stage I: Physics-Grounded Hand–Object Interaction Tracking
blocks.zh: 3.1 第一阶段:物理-手动-对象相互作用 跟踪

blocks.en: Mocap demonstrations record kinematics but not dynamics: contacts are frequently inconsistent and forces are absent altogether. In Stage I we aim to produce physically valid interaction data by training expert tracking policies via PPO ( Schulman et al., 2017 ) to imitate mocap demonstrations in a simulator. The resulting experts are then used in Stage II to learn a latent interaction prior for motion generation.
blocks.zh: Mocap示威记录了动静,但没有动态:接触往往不一致,而且完全没有力量。 在第一阶段,我们的目标是通过PPO(Schulman等,2017年)培训专家跟踪政策,以模拟模拟器中的模具演示,从而产生物理上有效的互动数据。 由此产生的专家随后被用于第二阶段,以便在产生运动之前学习潜在的相互作用。

Per-object experts and hard-mining. Rather than training one expert per sequence, which is expensive, we train two generalist experts for each object where each expert handles either single or bimanual interactions respectively.
We prune unrecoverable rollouts via early termination ( Peng et al., 2018 ) : episodes end on hand self-penetration or on excessive deviation from the reference measured by L samp L^{\text{samp}} , with the deviation threshold annealed as a curriculum. We further apply a hard-mining sampling strategy that biases the expert’s sequence pool toward low recent tracking-completion rates. See Appendix A for details. With this training curriculum, our per-sequence experts outperform ManipTrans ( Li et al., 2025a ) , and our per-object experts maintain a high success rate on the full dataset ( Table 1 ).

blocks.en: 3.2 Stage II: Interaction Prior Distillation
blocks.zh: 3.2 第二阶段:相互作用先蒸发

blocks.en:
The experts trained in Stage I are privileged policies that can physically reproduce mocap interactions, but are not generative themselves, as they require full reference hand motions that are unavailable at generation time.
The goal of Stage II is to compress the entire expert pool into a single goal-conditioned generative model whose learnable prior and decoder together act as an interaction-aware prior over physically simulated hand-object motions.
This prior–decoder pair is then used in Stage III as the latent backbone for RL exploration. Unlike prior motion-generation works that model human kinematics ( Luo et al., 2024a ; Tessler et al., 2024 ) without the object, our prior captures the coupled hand–object dynamics distilled from physically valid expert behavior.
blocks.zh:
在第一阶段接受过培训的专家是特有政策,可以实际复制摩卡普相互作用,但本身并不是遗传性的,因为他们需要代代相传的完全参考手动。
第二阶段的目标是将整个专家库压缩成一个单一的有入球条件的基因模型,其可学习的前和可解码器共同发挥在物理模拟手-物体运动之前的相互作用意识.
然后在第三阶段使用这个先前的-解码器对作为RL勘探的潜在主干. 与前作的人类动能模型化活性学作品不同(Luo等,2024a; Tessler等人, 2024年),没有对象,我们之前捕获了由物理上有效的专家行为所分泌的相接的手-物体动力学.

blocks.en: Stage II distillation yields a compact, interaction-aware latent space whose samples decode to physically plausible actions. To generalize beyond the limited training objects and interactions to novel objects, trajectories, and tasks, we explore this space with RL. The learned interaction prior improves sample efficiency and suppresses unnatural motion, providing a general approach to different manipulation tasks ( Sec. 4 ).

blocks.en: We compare our Stage I experts with a state-of-the-art mocap tracker and our interaction-prior generator with baselines on tabletop manipulation, object catching, and bimanual handover, consistently improving success rates. Videos and interactive qualitative results are on our project page .

blocks.en:
Datasets and Implementation Details. We use GRAB ( Taheri et al., 2020 ) as our dataset for training the interaction prior, but also rely on DexYCB ( Chao et al., 2021 ) as a secondary source to show the cross-dataset generalization capabilities of our GRAB-trained interaction prior.
All experiments are done within IsaacGym ( Makoviychuk et al., 2021 ) with MANO-consistent robotic hands. Further details on data split, preprocessing and simulator can be found in Appendix B .

所有实验均由IsaacGym(Makoviychuk等,2021年)用MANO-相容机器人手进行. 关于数据分拆、预处理和模拟的进一步详情见附录B。

blocks.en: Evaluation protocol and metrics. Unless otherwise stated, we evaluate each method using 100 simulated rollouts per sequence to account for simulator stochasticity. A rollout is terminated when the object deviates from the reference trajectory beyond a task-dependent distance threshold. To measure temporal robustness, we report tracking completion (TC in % \% ) , defined as the fraction of the reference trajectory completed before termination, and success rate (SR in % \% ) , defined as the fraction of rollouts that complete the entire sequence. For spatial precision, we report average object translation error ( E t E_{t} in cm) , the object rotation error ( E r E_{r} in ∘ ) , and, for the Stage I imitation task where reference motions are available, the mean per joint position error (MPJPE in cm) of the hands.

blocks.en: 4.1 Hand–Object Interaction Imitation
blocks.zh: 4.1 手势 对象交互 模仿

blocks.en:
We compare our Stage I experts with ManipTrans ( Li et al., 2025a ) , a state-of-the-art per-sequence imitation method.
Since ManipTrans does not support bimanual manipulation of single objects, we compare with it on GRAB50 which is a random subset of 50 single-handed GRAB ( Taheri et al., 2020 ) sequences.
As Table 1 shows, our experts trained per-sequence outperform ManipTrans trained on an identical setup on all metrics. We also train two experts per object, one for single-handed and one for bimanual interactions, on the full GRAB dataset. While the success rate slightly degrades, it is much more scalable than training one expert per sequence as done in ManipTrans and our overall success rate is still better than per-sequence ManipTrans experts. This shows that our method is a scalable data engine for learning physical interaction priors from human demonstrations.

我们把第一阶段的专家与马尼普特拉斯(Li等,2025a)相比较,这是一种最先进的逐序列仿真方法。
由于ManipTrans不支持对单个物体的双人操纵,我们与它相比,GRAB50是一个由50个单手GRAB(Taheri等,2020年)序列组成的随机子集.
如表1所示,我们的专家按顺序培训的成绩优于ManipTrans,对所有衡量标准都进行了相同的培训。 我们还对每个物体培训两名专家,一名是单手的,一名是双手的,关于全球资源信息数据库完整的数据集。 虽然成功率略有下降,但比Maniptrans公司每序列培训一名专家要容易得多,而且我们的总体成功率仍然比ManipTrans公司每序列专家好。 这表明我们的方法是一个可伸缩的数据引擎,用于学习人类演示的物理交互前身.

blocks.en: 4.2 Tabletop Manipulation
blocks.zh: 4.2 桌面操纵

blocks.en:
Our main application of the interaction prior is a task we call Tabletop Manipulation : given only a target object trajectory, a single policy must synthesize a physically plausible interaction for objects and trajectories it has never seen.
To this end, we train the Stage III residual policy π explore \pi_{\text{explore}} over a broad distribution of initial states and target trajectories.
blocks.zh:
我们之前互动的主要应用是我们称之为"Tabletop Manipulation"(Tabletop Manipulation)的任务:由于只有一个目标对象的轨迹,一个单一的政策必须合成它从未见过的物体和轨迹的物理上可行的相互作用.
为此,我们培训第三阶段剩余政策 探索\pi_{\text{explore} 超过最初状态和目标轨迹的广泛分布。

blocks.en:
Setup. Each training episode initializes the hands and the object from two different training sequences, so the policy starts from hand–object configurations that neither the experts nor the prior have encountered.
The target trajectory is, with equal probability, an original training trajectory or a procedurally generated lift-and-move trajectory.
The policy only ever interacts with training objects, whereas at evaluation both objects and trajectories are held out, making the policy zero-shot with respect to object geometry and motion.
We train one Stage III policy per dataset, on GRAB and on DexYCB, each on the respective training objects and on top of the same GRAB-trained prior.
Since generation is considerably harder than imitation, we relax the termination threshold for SR and TC to 10 cm. However, our advantage persists and even grows under stricter thresholds (Appendix E.2 ).
blocks.zh:
设相. 每个训练集都从两个不同的训练序列中初始化出手和对象,所以政策从专家或前辈都没有遇到的手-对象配置开始.
目标轨迹在概率上是原始的训练轨迹或按程序产生的升降和移动轨迹。
该政策只与训练对象相互作用,而在评价时,物体和轨迹都保持了,使政策在物体几何和运动方面零射出。
我们在每个数据集,在GRAB和DexYCB上,在相应的训练对象上,并在同一GRAB以前训练过的基础上,培训一个第三阶段的政策。
由于世代比模仿要困难得多,我们把SR和TC的终止门槛放宽到10厘米. 然而,我们的优势依然存在,甚至增加在更严格的门槛下(附录E.2)。

blocks.en: Baselines. We implement two alternatives within our framework, so that simulator, embodiment and physics are identical across methods (see Appendix C ). Action Space Exploration lets π explore \pi_{\text{explore}} act directly in the 102-dimensional joint space without use of a learned prior. Hand-Only Prior is similar to Omnigrasp ( Luo et al., 2024a ) and PULSE ( Luo et al., 2024b ) which lets π explore \pi_{\text{explore}} act in a latent space distilled from experts that track hand motion without the object.
blocks.zh: 基线。 在我们的框架内,我们实施两种选择,以便模拟、表现和物理方法相同(见附录C)。 Action Space Exploration 允许 \\ pi_{\text{ explore}}}在102维联合空间直接行动,而无需使用已学习过的前作. Hand-Only Prior与Omnigrasp(Luo等,2024a)和PULSE(Luo等,2024b)相似,后者允许 π探索\pi_{\text{explore}} 在来自跟踪无对象手动的专家所蒸馏出的潜在空间中行为.

blocks.en:
Results. To accelerate baseline learning, we additionally give both baselines a pre-grasp reward ( Dasari et al., 2023 ; Luo et al., 2024a ) and a difficulty curriculum ( Section C.3 ).
Our method needs neither and is trained on the full task distribution from the start.
As Table 2 shows, it nonetheless outperforms both baselines on unseen objects, improving the success rate over the strongest baseline by 14.0 points on GRAB and 16.9 points on DexYCB while also reducing object pose errors.
It also reaches the peak baseline performance with only 1/10 of the training time (in 900 epochs instead of 8900 epochs), demonstrating much higher training efficiency.
Because the DexYCB policy builds on the prior trained exclusively on GRAB, these results further show that the interaction prior generalizes across datasets. Qualitative results from both datasets are depicted in Figure 3 .

blocks.en:
The tabletop manipulation policy above is trained on similar interactions to those the prior was trained on. We now ask whether the interaction prior transfers to tasks whose dynamics are absent or very rare in the training data. We consider two: catching a thrown object, and a bimanual handover in which the object must be passed from the left hand to the right. Both are formulated as object-trajectory-conditioned manipulation generation, so the exploration policy π explore \pi_{\text{explore}} , the object split, and the baselines are unchanged from Section 4.2 . The object-tracking reward is complemented by simple task-specific terms. We show success rate in Tab. 3 and qualitative examples in Fig. 5 .

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion

blocks.en:
We propose PiHand, a physics-based framework for synthesizing dexterous hand–object interactions from target object trajectories.
Our key idea is to learn an explicit interaction prior that jointly models hand motion, object geometry, and contact dynamics, rather than relying on hand-only priors or reward-driven contact discovery.
PiHand trains imitation experts on mocap data, distills them into a conditional VAE prior, and explores its latent space to solve novel tasks.
Our experts improve SR over ManipTrans from 69.6% to 93.3% and maintain 84.8% SR on the full GRAB set with per-object experts.
On unseen GRAB and DexYCB objects, our tabletop manipulation policies achieve 14.0 and 16.9 points higher SR than the strongest baselines while learning roughly ten times faster. The same prior transfers to catching and handover, tasks rare or absent in its training data, achieving 2.0 × 2.0\times and 4.3 × 4.3\times the strongest-baseline SR, respectively.
We will release the processed data, expert policies, and generation model.
blocks.zh:
我们提议用PiHand作为物理框架,从目标物体轨迹中合成可变的手-物体相互作用。
我们的关键想法是先学习一种明确的相互作用,然后共同模拟手动、物体几何和接触动态,而不是依赖只手前科或奖励驱动的接触发现。
PiHand在mocap数据上训练模仿专家,将它们分馏为有条件的VAE前作,并探索其潜在的空间来解决新任务.
我们的专家在Maniptrans上改进了SR,从69.6%提高到93.3%,并在每个对象专家的GRAB全集上维持84.8%的SR.
在不见踪影的GRAB和DexYCB物体上,我们的平板电脑操纵政策取得了比最强基线更高的14.0分和16.9分,同时学习速度大约是十倍。 之前用于抓取和移交的相同转移,任务在培训数据中少有或缺失,分别实现2.0×2.0\时和4.3×4.3\时最强基线SR.
我们将公布已处理的数据、专家政策和生成模型。

blocks.en: Limitations. While PiHand clearly improves over prior baselines, several limitations remain. First, our tracking experts do not yet reach 100% success rate on the full GRAB dataset. Failures concentrate on extremely dynamic motions and sequences with heavy mocap noise, which we expect could be addressed with stricter termination criteria, curriculum learning, or higher-quality reference data. Second, we focus on rigid objects and do not model articulated objects such as those in ARCTIC ( Fan et al., 2023 ) . Extending the interaction prior to articulated geometry is an important next step. Third, our framework controls only the hands and does not consider full-body motion. Combining a full-body locomotion controller with our hand manipulation prior is a promising future direction. Finally, all experiments are conducted in simulation with a single MANO-based hand model. Transferring PiHand to real robotic hands would be an exciting direction, but it requires retargeting the prior to a different embodiment and bridging the gap between simulated and real sensing and actuation.
blocks.zh: 限制。 虽然PiHand显然比先前的基线有所改善,但仍有一些局限性。 首先,我们的追踪专家尚未在GRAB完整的数据集上达到100%的成功率. 失败集中在具有巨大摩卡普噪声的极活性运动和序列上,我们期望可以通过更严格的终止标准,课程学习,或质量更高的参考数据来解决. 第二,我们侧重于刚性物体,而不是像ARCTIC(Fan等,2023年)那样模拟已阐明物体。 在阐明几何之前扩大相互作用是下一个重要步骤。 第三,我们的框架只控制双手,不考虑全身运动。 将一个全能的运动控制器与我们之前的手操控相结合,是未来有希望的方向. 最后,所有实验都是用单一的基于MANO的手模型来模拟进行的. 将PiHand转移到真正的机器人手上将是一个令人振奋的方向,但它需要重新瞄准不同的前身,并弥合模拟与真实感知和活化之间的差距.

blocks.en: B.1 Datasets and Preprocessing
blocks.zh: B.1 数据集和预处理

blocks.en: GRAB. We use the GRAB ( Taheri et al., 2020 ) dataset as the primary source of interaction demonstrations. GRAB contains high-quality whole-body human grasping motions with detailed hand poses and contact annotations, collected from 10 subjects interacting with 51 everyday objects. We use 50 objects in our experiments, excluding doorknob due to physically implausible floating trajectories in the source data. Following prior work ( Taheri et al., 2022 ) , we partition the dataset into a training and a cross-object evaluation split. Raw motion capture sequences often contain extensive segments without actual object manipulation, such as the initial arm approach or the post-release retraction. To focus our policies on the core interaction dynamics, we temporally trim the sequences to segments that begin approximately 40 frames before the initial contact and end 40 frames after the contact is broken. Finally, to prevent lateral bias and increase data diversity, we apply a left-right mirroring augmentation to all sequences. After preprocessing, the final dataset contains 4,854 training sequences with an average length of 317.4 frames at 60 Hz.
blocks.zh: GRAB (英语). 我们使用GRAB(Taheri等,2020年)数据集作为互动演示的主要来源. GRAB包含高质量的全身人类接取动作,并带有详细的手姿和接触说明,从与51个日常物体互动的10个科目中收集. 我们在实验中使用了50个物体,不包括门把手,因为源数据中物理上不可信的浮动轨迹. 继先前的工作(Taheri等人,2022年)之后,我们把数据集分割成一个训练单元和一个交叉对象评价单元。 原始活性捕捉序列中往往含有没有实际物体操纵的很宽的片段,例如初始臂相接或释放后还原. 为了把政策重点放在核心互动动态上,我们暂时将序列剪切到在初始接触前开始的大约40帧的片段,并在接触中断后结束40帧. 最后,为了防止横向偏差并增加数据多样性,我们对所有序列采用左向右镜放大. 经过预处理后,最终数据集包含4,854个训练序列,平均长度为317.4帧,为60Hz.

blocks.en: DexYCB. We use DexYCB ( Chao et al., 2021 ) to evaluate generalization beyond GRAB. DexYCB contains sequences of 10 subjects grasping 20 objects from the YCB object set with a single hand, annotated with MANO hand poses and 6D object poses. In each sequence, a subject picks up a single target object from a table among several distractor objects and lifts it. We use the 250 right-handed sequences of subjects 1–5, covering all 20 objects. blocks.en: B.2 Simulation Setup and MANO Integration

blocks.en: To bridge MANO-based human demonstrations and physical simulation, we construct our simulated robotic hand directly from the MANO model ( Romero et al., 2017 ) . The simulated hand follows the kinematic joint structure of the mean-shape MANO template in a flat-hand pose, with rigid-body collision geometries obtained by segmenting the corresponding MANO mesh. This design preserves a direct correspondence between the simulated and the visual hand representation, so that simulated trajectories can be mapped back to MANO without error-prone kinematic retargeting. While the GRAB dataset contains motions from 10 different human subjects with varying hand shapes, we use this single template hand across all environments. Rather than retargeting each demonstration to the template, we let the Stage I tracking policy learn to compensate for the remaining morphology mismatch during RL training.

blocks.en: For all simulated objects, we set the volumetric density to 500 kg/m 3 and the contact friction coefficient to 0.7. Prior methods often use elevated friction values that artificially simplify grasping, such as 1.0 in Omnigrasp ( Luo et al., 2024a ) and 1.5 in MaskedManipulator ( Tessler et al., 2025 ) . Our lower friction prevents unrealistic surface adhesion and encourages the policy to learn physically plausible force-closure grasps. Simulation and policy execution are synchronized at 60 Hz. Since IsaacGym assumes convex meshes for efficient collision detection, we decompose all object meshes into convex parts using Wei et al. (2022) .
blocks.zh: 对所有模拟物体,我们规定体积密度为500公斤/米3,接触摩擦系数为0.7. 先前的方法经常使用高摩擦值来人为地简化取取取,如Omnigrasp (Luo等,2024a)和MaskedManiplator的1.5. (Tessler等人,2025年). 我们的更低的摩擦防止了不切实际的地表粘合,并鼓励政策学习物理上可信的强力封闭控制. 模拟和政策执行同步60赫兹. 由于IsaacGym为高效的相撞探测而假定了对流网,因此我们利用Wei等人(2022年)将所有对象对流网分解为对流部分.

blocks.en: B.3 Training Times
blocks.zh: B.3 培训时报

blocks.en: All models are trained on a single Nvidia A100. Each Stage I expert is trained for up to 6 h, however, on average they converge after only 1 or 2 h. Distillation into the latent interaction prior takes 24 h. Training the Tabletop Manipulation policy takes up to 36 h, while the catching and handover policies are trained for 20 h.

blocks.en: Appendix C Baselines
blocks.zh: 附录C 基线

blocks.en: Several existing methods qualify as baselines for generative hand–object interaction, most notably full action space exploration frameworks such as GraspXL ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) , and human-motion latent exploration methods such as Omnigrasp ( Luo et al., 2024a ) and the work Braun et al. (2023) .
blocks.zh: 一些现有方法符合基因手-物体相互作用的基准条件,最显著的是GraspXL(张等,2025年a)和Omnigrasp(Luo等,2024年a)和Braun等人的工作(2023年)等人类运动潜入的探索方法。

blocks.en: However, conducting fair, direct comparisons using official codebases is challenging for several reasons. First, some methods lack publicly available or well-documented code, making reproduction outside of their original environment practically impossible without major engineering efforts. Second, existing methods leverage vastly different training datasets. Crucially, differences in the underlying physics simulation—such as the choice of engine, friction coefficients, object mass densities, and the specific embodiment—fundamentally alter the difficulty of the task. For instance, full-body methods ( Braun et al., 2023 ; Luo et al., 2024a ) approximate an SMPL-X ( Pavlakos et al., 2019 ) body using coarse geometric primitives (capsules and cuboids), leading to radically different contact dynamics than high-fidelity, MANO-based hand interactions.
blocks.zh: 然而,出于若干原因,利用官方代码库进行公平、直接的比较具有挑战性。 首先,一些方法缺乏公开的或有详细记录的代码,使得没有重大工程努力,在原有环境之外进行复制实际上是不可能的. 第二,现有方法利用了截然不同的培训数据集。 关键的是,基本的物理模拟——如发动机的选择、摩擦系数、物体质量密度和具体表现——的差异,根本上改变了任务的难度。 例如,全体方法(Braun等人,2023;Luo等人,2024a)使用粗糙的几何原始物(capsules and cuboids)来近似一具SMPL-X(Pavlakos等人,2019年)身体,导致接触动力学与高纯度,基于MANO的手动相互作用完全不同.

blocks.en: To isolate the impact of the interaction-first prior and ensure a strictly fair comparison, we implement the paradigms of these baselines directly within our framework. By standardizing the simulator, physics parameters, and embodiment across all methods, any observed difference in performance can be attributed to the approaches themselves rather than to environmental discrepancies. In the following we describe the concrete details of our baseline implementations.
blocks.zh: 为了孤立互动——先行的相互作用——的影响,并确保严格公平的比较,我们直接在我们的框架内实施这些基线的范式。 通过将模拟器、物理参数和所有方法的体现标准化,所观察到的性能差异可以归因于方法本身而不是环境差异。 在下文中,我们描述了我们基线执行工作的具体细节。

In level 1, environments are initialized with matched hand and object poses drawn from the same training sequence. Level 2 adds continuous z z -axis rotation augmentations to both the initial poses and the target trajectory. Level 3 completely decouples the initial configurations of hands and object by sampling the hand pose from a different training sequence than the object pose. Our method is trained on this highest level from the start.
blocks.zh: 课程 事实证明,对高度多样化的初始面貌和轨迹进行直接培训对基线来说是困难的,因此,我们引入了一个三级课程,逐步增加任务的复杂性。 在1级,环境被初始化,由同一训练序列所取出匹配的手和物体外形. 2级在初始姿势和目标轨迹上都增加了连续的z-轴旋转增强. 第三级完全解开手和物体的初始配置,从不同训练序列中取样手和物体的姿势。 我们的方法从一开始就是在这个最高水平上训练的。

blocks.en: D.3 Novel Tasks: Common Setup

blocks.en: Both novel tasks of catching and bimanual handover reuse the generative machinery of Sec. 4 : a task is specified entirely by an object reference trajectory, and π explore \pi_{\text{explore}} is optimized with an object-tracking reward, complemented by a small number of task-specific terms described below. This section defines the shared setup, and the following two sections define the reference trajectories, task-specific terminations, and the training and evaluation protocol of each task.
blocks.zh: 捕捉和双人交接两个新任务 重用 Sec. 4 的基因机械:一个任务完全由对象参考轨迹来指定,而"探索\pi_{\text{explore}}"则被优化为对象跟踪奖励,辅以下文所描述的少数任务特定术语. 本节定义了共享设置,后两节则定义了参考轨迹,任务特定终止,以及每项任务的培训和评价协议.

blocks.en: Scene. Neither task involves a physical table. The bimanual hands float in free space.
blocks.zh: 场景 两个任务都涉及物理表. 双手浮出自由空间.

blocks.en: Reward. The reward is the exponentiated combination of an object position term (weight 10) and a fingertip-proximity term (weight 10 for catching, 5 for handover).
blocks.zh: 报恩. 奖励是物体位置名词(重量10个)和指尖相近名词(重量10个用于捕捉,5个用于交接)的推论组合.

blocks.en: Termination. An episode terminates when the object leaves a task-specific radius around the reference (30 cm for catching, 15 cm for handover), when the nearest wrist is farther than a task-specific distance from the object (2.0 m and 1.2 m), or on self-penetration.
blocks.zh: 终止 当物体离开特定任务半径围绕参考物(30厘米用于捕捉,15厘米用于接接),最近的手腕比特定任务距离物体更远(2.0米和1.2米),或自穿行时,一集终止.

blocks.en: Objects. Catching uses all 45 training objects and the 5 held-out objects of Sec. 4 . Handover requires a left-hand grasp frame to initialize from; five training objects ( knife , scissors , teapot , toothbrush , torussmall ) have none in GRAB and are excluded, leaving 40. All 5 held-out objects have left-hand grasp frames in the evaluation split.
blocks.zh: 物体。 捕捉使用所有45个训练对象和5个被扣留的Sec. 4的对象. 交接需要左取相框从中初始化;有五个训练对象(刀、剪刀、茶壶、牙刷、托鲁斯小等)在GRAB中无一被排除,只剩下40个。 所有5个被搁置的物体在评价分割中都有左取框.

blocks.en: D.4 Catching
blocks.zh: D.4 捕捉

blocks.en: Reference trajectory. The object is launched on a ballistic arc that passes through an intercept point, and the reference then holds the object at that point for at least 60 frames. To make the reference physically exact, the arc is integrated with the simulator’s own symplectic Euler scheme rather than the closed-form parabola. After k k substeps the position is 𝐩 k = 𝐩 0 + k ​ Δ ​ t ​ 𝐯 0 + 𝐠 ​ Δ ​ t 2 ​ k ​ ( k + 1 ) / 2 , \mathbf{p}_{k}=\mathbf{p}_{0}+k\,\Delta t\,\mathbf{v}_{0}+\mathbf{g}\,\Delta t^{2}\,k(k{+}1)/2, and the launch velocity is solved from this expression. Objects are given a random initial orientation and a random angular velocity of up to 8 rad/s; because the simulator rotates rigid bodies about the center of mass, the reference is computed for the center of mass and mapped back to the object origin using the per-object inertial offset. Episodes last 160 frames (2.67 s at 60 Hz).

Episoides上架160帧(2.67 s at 60 Hz).

blocks.en: Randomization. The intercept point is displaced from the nominal catch point by up to ( ± 0.35 , ± 0.25 , ± 0.30 ) (\pm 0.35,\pm 0.25,\pm 0.30) m, the hands start at a common random offset of up to ( ± 0.15 , ± 0.10 , ± 0.10 ) (\pm 0.15,\pm 0.10,\pm 0.10) m, the launch position lies 0.3–1.0 m from the intercept point at an azimuth of ± 75 ∘ \pm 75^{\circ} and a height of − 0.3 -0.3 to + 0.6 +0.6 m relative to it, and flight time is 15–70 frames (0.25–1.17 s). Both hands start open, palms facing each other 12 cm either side of the nominal catch point.

blocks.en: Wrist economy. With the tracking reward alone, interaction prior-based policies learn to send one hand out to the object early and ride along with it for the entire flight, a behavior the prior’s data encourages (a GRAB hand is always near the object) and that the fingertip-proximity term pays for on every flight frame. We add two penalties on the wrists’ linear and angular speed (weights 2.0 and 0.3), applied only before the object reaches the intercept point, and scale the fingertip-proximity term to 10% of its weight during the same window.
blocks.zh: 手腕经济. 仅凭追踪奖励,互动前的政策就学会了及早将一只手送到物体上,并随同它一起搭乘整个飞行过程,一种先前的数据鼓励的行为(GRAB的手总是靠近物体),而且指尖-相近的术语在每个飞行框上支付. 我们对手腕的线性速度和角快(重量2.0和0.3)加了两个惩罚,只在物体到达截取点之前适用,并将指尖-相近词缩放到同一窗口内重量的10%。

Contact between the left hand and the object terminates the episode, and the fingertip-proximity and wrist-economy terms are computed for the right hand only. blocks.en: Training and evaluation. All policies are trained for 20h on a single A100. All methods receive the same wall-clock budget; because action space exploration does not evaluate a decoder at every step, it completes more updates in this time. Policies are evaluated deterministically with 20 episodes per object, giving 900 episodes on the 45 training objects and 100 on the 5 held-out objects. Throws are generated from a fixed seed, so every method is evaluated on the same sequence of objects, launch states and intercept points.

On the held-out objects, our bimanual policy catches the object in 87.0% of the episodes, compared with 43.0% for action space exploration, while the hand-only prior almost never succeeds. The picture is the same on the training objects, and our policy performs as well on the held-out objects as on the training objects. Restricting the catch to the right hand lowers the success rate to 78.0%, but even this harder variant clearly outperforms both bimanual baselines.

blocks.zh: D.5 移交

blocks.en: Initial state. Each episode starts from a GRAB frame in which the left hand alone holds the lifted object: the object center is more than 10 cm above the table, at least four left-hand contact bodies and at most one right-hand contact body touch it, and its speed is below 0.2 m/s. Where the object has same-actor handover sequences (GRAB intent offhand ), 70% of resets are drawn from the pre-transfer part of those sequences. The hands and object are translated so that the object starts on the left side of the workspace, x ∈ [ 0.30 , 0.45 ] x\in[0.30,0.45] m in the table frame, with the right hand at its GRAB pose relative to the object. Five training objects ( knife , scissors , teapot , toothbrush , torussmall ) have no such frame and are excluded, leaving 22,641 start frames over 40 training objects. The five held-out objects have 1,442 start frames in the evaluation split.
blocks.zh: 初为州. 每集从GRAB框架开始,其中由左手单独持有被解除的对象:物体中心位于表上方10厘米以上,至少有4个左手接触机构,并最多有1个右手接触机构触摸它,其速度低于0.2 m/s. 如果物体有同一种函数的交接序列(GRAB意图离手),70%的重置序列取自这些序列的转移前部分. 手和对象被翻译出后,使对象从工作空间的左侧起步,x  [0.30,0.45] x\in [0.30,0.45] m 在表框中,右手放在它的GRAB上相对对象而起. 5个训练用具(刀、剪刀、茶壶、牙刷、托鲁斯小等)没有这种相框,不包括在40个训练用具上。 五个被搁置的物体在评价分拆中有1,442个起始帧.

blocks.en: A GRAB frame copied into the simulator is kinematically correct but not necessarily force-closed: the object may slip out of the left hand before any policy acts. To separate the handover from the problem of establishing a stable grasp in the first place, we test every held-out start frame without a policy. The hands are held at their initial joint configuration and wrist pose by the PD controller, and we record the displacement of the object from its initial position. A frame is kept if the object moves less than 5 cm within the first 30 frames (0.5 s). Because the test involves no policy, it selects the same states for every method. Of the 1,442 held-out frames, 160 pass.
blocks.zh: 复制到模拟器中的GRAB框架在动能上是正确的,但不一定强制关闭:对象可能在任何政策行动之前从左手滑出. 为了把移交与建立稳定把握的问题区分开来,我们在没有政策的情况下测试每一个被搁置的起动框架。 手被PD控制器按起最初的联合配置和手腕姿势所握取来,我们记录物体从初始位置转移的情况. 如果对象在前30个帧(0.5 s)内移动不到5cm,则会保留一个帧. 因为测试不涉及政策,所以它为每一种方法选择相同的状态. 在1,442个被扣出线架中,160个通过.

blocks.en: Reference trajectory. The reference holds the object in place for 30 frames ( settle ), during which terminations are masked so that the policy can establish its own grip. It then moves the object in a straight line at constant height to x ∈ [ − 0.45 , − 0.30 ] x\in[-0.45,-0.30] m at 0.2–0.4 m/s, with 0.5 s velocity ramps and a 0.5 s dwell at the midpoint, and finally holds it for at least 60 frames. Episodes last 420 frames (7 s).
blocks.zh: 参考轨迹. 参考对象为30个帧(结算)所设置,在此期间,终止被掩盖,以便政策能够确立自己的控制. 然后以直线将物体在常高下移动至××[−0.45,−0.30] x\in [−0.45,-0.30] m以0.2–0.4 m/s的速度移动,在中点有0.5个速度坡道和0.5 s 停留,并最后至少为60帧. 平生相片上方为420帧(7 s).

blocks.en: Wrist zones. The left wrist may not move right of x = − 0.08 x=-0.08 m and the right wrist may not move left of x = + 0.08 x=+0.08 m. The zones are enforced by clamping the wrist position targets, and an episode terminates if a wrist is pushed more than 2 cm past its zone. Since both zones exclude the far side of the workspace, no single hand can carry the object from start to goal: an episode that runs to completion has brought the object into the right hand’s zone.
blocks.zh: 腕带. 左手腕可不向右移动x=−0.08 x-0.08 m,而右手腕可不向左移动x=+0.08 x-0.08 m. 区域通过夹住手腕位置目标来强制实施,如果一个手腕被推过2厘米以上区域,则一集终止. 由于这两个区都排除了工作区最远的一面,因此没有任何一手能从头到尾地携带物体:一出跑到完成的一集将物体带入了右手区.

blocks.en: Per-hand proximity. The fingertip-proximity term takes the nearest fingertip of each hand separately and sums the two distances, so that the free hand receives a gradient towards the object instead of being masked by the hand already holding it.
blocks.zh: 亲相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相. 指尖-相近名词分别取出每只手最相近的指尖并将两相距相加,使自由手得到向物体的梯度,而不是被已经握住的手所遮住.

blocks.en: Metrics. SR and TC are defined as before. The translation error E t E_{t} is the mean distance between object and reference from the end of the settle phase until termination.

blocks.en: E.1 Robustness to Physical Perturbations
blocks.zh: E.1 物理扰动的强度

blocks.en: We test how the Tabletop Manipulation policies of all three methods cope with physical conditions that differ from training, varying one factor at a time on the held-out objects ( Table 12 ). Changing the surface friction affects all methods similarly, and higher friction makes grasping easier for every method. Heavier objects, however, clearly separate the methods: at four times the nominal mass, our policy loses 11.7% of its success rate, while the hand-only prior and action space exploration lose 67.2% and 52.8%. Our policy is also the most robust to action noise. Under all perturbations our method retains the highest absolute success rate.

blocks.en: E.4 Residual Bound
blocks.zh: E.4 残余边界

blocks.en: We ablate the residual bound B B by training Stage III policies with B ∈ { 0.5 , 1 , 2 , 3 , 5 , 10 , ∞ } B\in\{0.5,1,2,3,5,10,\infty\} and evaluating them on held-out objects at matched training epochs ( Figure 4 ). The bound trades task success against grasp diversity. Tight bounds leave the policy too little room to correct the prior, and success rises steadily as the bound is relaxed ( Figure 4 4(a) ). Up to B = 5 B{=}5 , the deployed latents stay within the prior’s latent distribution ( Figure 4 4(c) ), and hand usage closely follows the human reference ( Figure 4 4(b) ). For B ≥ 10 B\geq 10 the bound no longer constrains the residual, and B = 10 B{=}10 behaves like the unbounded policy. Success improves only marginally, but the latents drift away from the prior and the policy collapses almost entirely to bimanual grasps, discarding the grasp diversity encoded in the prior. We therefore use B = 5 B{=}5 , which retains most of the unbounded success rate while keeping the hand usage close to the human reference.
